sourceBasis.temporalLimitation: The original metadata claims 2017, but original shapefile XML records append/dissolve processing in August 2021. The fixed file is mixed or uncertified vintage. actualPBF.method: Decode actual hashed MVT lines and both literal incident fill-ring networks including zero-area integer rings, matching the existing published delivery proof. Continuous distance-to-set bounds use adaptive 1-Lipschitz segment envelopes, not samples alone. Native/PBF-line, native/fill-ring and actual-PBF-line/fill-ring each retain their separate 1.5-grid-unit limits; display/line and display/fill have DP300m plus that original limit. The unchanged base package's full surface coverage remains the separately pinned original delivery proof.
actualPBF.renderingLimitation: Installed classifyRings skips exactly zero integer signed-area rings. Their bytes and integer-zero certificates are retained in the ledger; the literal-ring distance gate does not claim those degenerate rings enclose rendered pixels. This is an unchanged base-PBF representation effect, not an administrative or gameplay footprint modification.
